text:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — planning a staged deprecation for the rtx-2b family that a few mid-market customers still have pinned. Need to align on cutover criteria, canary roll %, and concrete rollback triggers. Keeping this low-friction for customers is the priority.
Sam Ortiz: +1. Can we start with the benchmark set we used for onboarding? need pass/fail thresholds. also: timeline constraints from sales? @Sales Ops
Sales Ops: Sales asks for a 60d heads-up and an option for 1-off pin exceptions for >$50k ARR accounts.
Alice Chen: For benchmarks, propose gating on: p95 latency <= 300ms (on dedicated profile), semantic drop <= 2% on critical prompt set, and no increase in hallucination rate > 1.5x.
Miguel Rivera: Also require embedding recall for search customers — cosine similarity avg drop < 0.02 on our 10k query sample. If that fails, we abort canary.
Sam Ortiz: How big should canary be? 5% traffic for 48h then 20% for 7d? Or do we want a slower ramp given pinning sensitivity?
Priya Nair: Thinking: 1) 2% for 24h (smoke), 2) 10% for 72h (early signals), 3) 50% for 7d, then full. Each step must pass all gating metrics with no rollback triggers.
Alice Chen: Rollback triggers (proposed): any p95 regression >20% absolute, semantic drop >3%, embedding recall drop >0.04, or error rate spike >0.5%. If triggered, automatic fallback to pinned variant and page on-call.
Miguel Rivera: We should encode an automatic golden-check run every hour during canary to detect quiet regressions. Add an alert for silent drift.
Priya Nair: Agreed. I'll draft the rollout config. Quick config sketch:
```
canary_steps:
  - percent: 2
    duration: 24h
  - percent: 10
    duration: 72h
  - percent: 50
    duration: 7d
gating_metrics:
  p95_latency_ms: <=300
  semantic_f1_drop_pct: <=2
  embedding_cosine_drop: <=0.02
rollback_triggers:
  p95_latency_pct_increase: >20
  semantic_f1_pct_increase: >3
  embedding_cosine_increase: >0.04
  error_rate_absolute_increase: >0.5
```
Sam Ortiz: Nice. Two operational asks: 1) add a per-customer opt-out header so Sales can request holds; 2) surface a per-tenant migration dashboard for us to track stuck migrations.
Priya Nair: We'll add X-Redwood-Pin-Override header for exceptions and a dashboard in Console (migration status + metric deltas).
Sales Ops: Confirmed — need a comms template for customers and SSO-safe link to opt into a migration test.
Miguel Rivera: One security note: for private deployments we must ensure the fallback path doesn't leak new-model logs to customer audit streams. Add a review step with Sec.
Priya Nair: Good catch. I'll loop in Eng Security for sign-off.
deploy-bot: [deployment plan created] Deployment ID: dp-1777, linked to canary config draft.
Priya Nair: I'll post the formal playbook by EOD tomorrow. If anyone has strong objections to thresholds or ramping cadence, flag now. Otherwise I'll move to PR for ops-runbook + console changes. :thumbsup:
